name: Mori no Nyanko
source:
Cat-girl Kyoku Ran lives in the forest together with her mother. One day she gets on a tree in search of bird eggs and discovers a girl with wings on a tree. The girl does not remember her name, so Kyoku gives her name Kotori-chan. They start to explore this forest together.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
